main.description: Gets the latest message of every text channel in a community that the requesting user may read, for channel list previews. Channels with no message the user may see are absent.

community.description: The community to summarize channels of.

summaries.description: One summary per readable text channel that has a visible message.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user is not a member of this community, or is banned from it.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.
